units.source_text: 后来名人患病引起了各种纠纷，大竹七段多次扬言要放弃这盘棋。

en.t: Later, the Master's illness gave rise to all kinds of disputes, and Otake, seventh dan, repeatedly declared that he would abandon the game.

units.source_text: 作为晚辈，这种态度对老名人是不懂礼让，对病人是缺少人情味，

en.t: For a junior player, such an attitude showed no proper deference toward the old Master and little human sympathy toward a sick man,

units.source_text: 有的只是大道理，或者不讲道理，弄得召集人狼狈不已，难以为情。

en.t: offering only lofty principles, or else no reason at all, and leaving the organizer thoroughly embarrassed and at a loss.

units.source_text: 不过，正当的主张总是在七段这边。

en.t: Even so, the justifiable position was always on the seventh dan's side.

units.source_text: 再说，七段担心让一步就得让百步，

en.t: Besides, the seventh dan feared that if he yielded one step, he would have to yield a hundred,

units.source_text: 而且让一步，情绪一松懈，就可能成为败局的起点。

en.t: and that yielding even once, if it loosened his resolve, might become the starting point of defeat.

units.source_text: 到了最后决胜负的时刻，恐怕也不应该这样做。

en.t: At the final moment when victory and defeat were to be decided, it was probably not something he should do.

units.source_text: 七段的态度是这盘棋无论如何也要取胜，并且早已下定决心。

en.t: The seventh dan's attitude was that he had to win this game at any cost, and he had long since made up his mind.

units.source_text: 对手随心所欲，他自然不能听之任之。

en.t: If his opponent acted however he pleased, he naturally could not simply let it pass.

units.source_text: 另一方面，我甚至想，也可能七段认为对手是名人，会照样任性，

en.t: On the other hand, I even thought that perhaps the seventh dan believed his opponent, being the Master, would go on behaving willfully as before,

units.source_text: 所以更加顽固地坚持按规则行事。

en.t: and for that reason became all the more stubborn in insisting that everything be done according to the rules.
